# Vox Programming Language — LLM / Agent Documentation Index
> Vox is an AI-native full-stack programming language that compiles to Rust and TypeScript.
> It is designed first as a target for large language models, then for human developers.

## Agent Policy Entry Points
- [AGENTS.md](https://voxlang.org/AGENTS.md): Cross-tool policy for all coding agents (required reading)
- [GEMINI.md](https://voxlang.org/GEMINI.md): Antigravity-specific overlay
- [CLAUDE.md](https://voxlang.org/CLAUDE.md): Claude Code overlay

## Core Documentation
- [Getting Started](https://voxlang.org/tutorials/tut-getting-started/): Install the toolchain and build your first app
- [Language Syntax Reference](https://voxlang.org/reference/ref-syntax/): Full syntax specification
- [CLI Reference](https://voxlang.org/reference/cli/): All vox subcommands
- [Environment Variables SSOT](https://voxlang.org/reference/env-vars/): Configuration surface
- [Secrets (Secret Management)](https://voxlang.org/reference/secrets-ssot/): API keys and credentials

## Architecture Authority
- [Where things live](https://voxlang.org/architecture/where-things-live/): Concept → crate lookup table
- [Classification SSOT](https://voxlang.org/architecture/classification-ssot-2026/): Canonical surface classifications
- [Contributor Hub](https://voxlang.org/contributors/contributor-hub/): Start here; Architecture SSOTs are listed in the Starlight sidebar

## Contributor Hub
- [Contributor Hub](https://voxlang.org/contributors/contributor-hub/): Entry point for contributors
- [Documentation Governance](https://voxlang.org/contributors/documentation-governance/): Doc authority map
- [Agent Instruction Architecture](https://voxlang.org/contributors/agent-instruction-architecture/): How AI agents should navigate this repo

## AI Coding-Assistant Integration
- [How-to: wire AI assistants to vox_validate_source MCP](https://voxlang.org/how-to/how-to-mcp-vox-validate/): Configure Claude Desktop / Cursor to validate AI-generated Vox source against the real compiler with structured autofix suggestions; documents the diagnostic shape (`code` + `fixes`), the iterate-against-the-compiler loop, and the most useful diagnostic-code namespaces.
